_comment: Curated per-title profiles for Madeira. Entries here win over an imported Protonfixes profile with the same App ID or executable. A profile may be matched by Steam App ID ('appid'), by executable base name ('executables', case-insensitive), or by a fragment of the install path ('path_contains'). Everything is optional; a title with no profile simply launches as it always did.

games.title: Thumper
games.notes: Reference title for Madeira. Starts as its own program (no Steam client needed) and reaches gameplay.

fallbacks.name: Disable the Steam overlay
fallbacks.note: The overlay hook is the usual reason an older Unity title stops presenting.

games.title: ULTRAKILL
games.notes: Reference title for Madeira; D3D11 through DXMT.

games.title: Stray
games.notes: The Stray.exe launcher builds its child's command line itself and drops the RHI switch, so Madeira can start Stray-Win64-Shipping.exe directly with -dx11.
issues: The launcher must be bypassed for the D3D11 renderer to be selected.

fallbacks.name: Direct3D 9 renderer
fallbacks.note: If the D3D11 path fails on DXMT, the UE4 D3D9 renderer is the next thing to try.

games.title: Marvel Cosmic Invasion
games.notes: FNA has no OpenGL backend on iOS; Madeira selects the D3D11 backend so the game routes through DXMT.

games.title: Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition
games.notes: dinput8 prefers a native DLL so the optional DSfix proxy (DATA/dinput8.dll) loads, and falls back to the builtin otherwise.
issues: Requires a DirectX 9 path; see the d3dx9 and d3dcompiler dependencies.

fallbacks.name: Builtin DirectInput 8
fallbacks.note: An old DSfix build with a broken proxy makes the native dinput8 fail to load.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto IV
games.notes: GFWL sign-in is unavailable; offline content only.
issues: Games for Windows LIVE online services are gone.

fallbacks.name: Report Windows 7
fallbacks.note: Some GTA IV builds refuse to start on a newer reported version.

games.title: Fallout 3
games.notes: GFWL is unavailable; the game runs offline.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.notes: Protonfixes appends -vulkan, which is a fix on Proton because Proton renders through Vulkan. Madeira presents through Metal and has no Vulkan, so the equivalent is the game's Direct3D 12 renderer: -vulkan becomes -dx12 and -fullscreen is kept.

games.title: Steam client
games.notes: The client's own Windows build, started with its embedded browser's GPU and sandbox paths off and the overlay helper disabled. Madeira's Dock starts games without the client, so this profile matters when the client itself is added to the library.
unavailable_fixes: the pre-exec hook Winlator runs before the client
the renderer configuration Winlator applies to the client's own Direct3D

games.title: Steam web helper
games.notes: The embedded browser the client's interface is drawn with. It is given Wine's software renderer so that it takes no graphics device, and strict memory ordering because its threads share state without barriers.
unavailable_fixes: forcing Direct3D 8, 9, 10, 10_1, 10core, 11, DirectDraw and DXGI to Wine's builtin libraries, which Winlator does; on Madeira d3d9/10/11/dxgi are DXMT's, and the helper is kept off the GPU instead

games.title: Chrono Trigger
games.notes: Winlator's fix for this title disables Wine's built-in streaming decoder (winegstreamer=d). On Madeira winegstreamer is the decoder itself, so applying that by default would remove its video and audio rather than repair them; the same fix is kept as a fallback, for a prefix that has native codecs, and the component route (native-quartz) is the other.

fallbacks.name: Disable the built-in streaming decoder
fallbacks.note: Winlator's fix, kept as an attempt: it is only right when a native codec payload is installed, because Madeira has no other decoder for these streams.

games.title: Disciples II (GOG)
games.notes: Winlator makes Wine's own DirectDraw and Direct3D 8 libraries win over the ones the game ships, and gives the container the 2002-era adapter settings this recipe carries. On Madeira the builtin path is wined3d, so a DirectDraw wrapper (cnc-ddraw) is the fallback if it cannot present through Metal.

fallbacks.name: DirectDraw wrapper
fallbacks.note: Used when Wine's builtin DirectDraw cannot present this title on Metal.

games.title: Moto Racer (GOG)
games.notes: Winlator pairs this title with a native winmm.dll (winmm=n,b): its audio and timing go through waveOut, and Wine's builtin one gives it the wrong device mix. The override only takes effect once a winmm.dll is in the payload directory (Winetricks' winmm verb provides one).

games.title: Far Cry 3
games.notes: Winlator needs a Wine patch to stop this title opening the service control manager (WINE_DO_NOT_OPEN_SC_MANAGER). Madeira keeps the service control manager and removes the race in the same path instead (patches/wine-rpcss-scm-bootstrap.patch), which is the failure this patch works around.
unavailable_fixes: the Wine patch that makes the service control manager unopenable
